content: Renegades Outline.  Six months after Vengeance  We open with Blake getting the shit beat out of him tied to a chair, he is being interrogated and one of them says they should sell him to Vengeance who has a bounty on humans, Blake asks questions trying to find out where Vengeance is, when he gets the answer, he kicks the shit out of the  interrogators  , walking out of the room.  He catches back up with the team Blake has gone rogue, stripped of his ship and rank  he and the crew minus Shira who stayed. Ranger and is now the Captain of the Revenant. Blake doesn’t hold any ill  will;  the rest of the crew is with him as he  search’s  the galaxy for his daughter.  Blake is a mess,  disheveled,  unshaven and a  drunk,  but a functioning one.  Rom stayed because he still believes in his captain and is trying to save him from himself,  Davi is also still with the captain, he also is trying to save him. He is a driven man, a shell of his former self as he combs every dark alley in search of information.  The Shadows have now given  their  full attention to the war, finding out one of the ancients still lives, they hunt her  down,  they have not been able to fly  their  ships, it requires the DNA of an  ancient,   with that , they are able to activate there ships, bringing them out of storage they begin to hunt the ranges, Blake hears stories of large  black beasts emerging from space to destroy the rangers and capturing the planets that have left the empire or have aligned themselves with the Alliance of Planets. He ignores  them,  his only drive is to find his daughter.  Following Vengeances path he goes from bad guy to bad guy, during one of his trips he ends up on a planet and watches first hand as the AI’s take control of a system , slaughtering the Ranger  Presence  and bombarding targets until the planet submits, Vengeance is not there and he manages to escape, despite his cavalier front the events are bothering him, he could help , but stays the course.  During his investigations messages and other things began to filter to him, someone is trying to contact him,  and he becomes more and more curious.  Finally he agrees to meet with the mysterious voice and goes to a back water  planet,   When he gets there he finds another ancient,  she explains what has happened and how the ancients got there ships back, she also explains they will wipe out the entire galaxy, Using the location of his daughter as leverage, she convinces Marcus to take on the Shadows,  The Ancient explains about the dreadnought, the warn ender, the machine that the ancients made to finally take out there enemy and  gives Marcus what he needs to control the behemoth.  He goes after his daughter and finds her, frees her and they have a moment,  She takes off , and leaves him a note meanwhile the Rangers catch up to him and he meets with  Seafu , they are running and hiding , but they can’t do that forever, there is a meeting of the alliance and they will be there for security, Marcus tells him about the  dreadnoght  and  Seafu  orders Shira to take him out there,  They go out to the location and find the giant ship, it is ten times the size  o  the Revenant and the firepower is godlike.
